tagline: From gut-feel spreadsheets to agentic deal intelligence — AI is turning pricing into a real-time revenue engine
trigger: Thoma Bravo’s $1.4B acquisition of PROS Holdings (Dec 2025) + McKinsey finding that 65–85% of B2B pricing executives plan AI adoption within 3 years signals rapid market consolidation and enterprise urgency

timeline.event: Pricefx closes $65M Series C led by Apax Digital, bringing total raised to $130M — institutional conviction in cloud-native pricing SaaS
ChatGPT launch sparks LLM experimentation in pricing; vendors begin embedding natural-language interfaces for pricing explanations and scenario modeling
Pricefx reports 40% annual revenue growth in 2023 and 83% YoY increase in ARR per new customer — fastest growth in company history
Competera launches Store-Level Optimization + AI Pricing Assistant; named Representative Vendor in Gartner’s 2024 Market Guide for retail pricing optimization

Thoma Bravo acquires PROS Holdings for $1.4B (Dec); B2B arm merged with Conga forming a CPQ+pricing powerhouse. McKinsey survey: 65–85% of B2B pricing execs plan gen/agentic AI adoption within 1–3 years
Vendavo releases AI Pricing Assistant on SAP Business Technology Platform with natural-language explanations; 55% of European retailers planning GenAI dynamic pricing pilots (Euromonitor)

pestal.impact: EU antitrust authorities launched multiple investigations into algorithmic pricing collusion (July 2025); EU Digital Fairness Act targets manipulative personalisation and opaque dynamic pricing in B2C — compliance costs rising

McKinsey: a 1% price increase boosts operating profit by 6–14%; companies lose up to 5% of EBITDA annually to pricing errors. Post-inflation margin pressure makes AI pricing the highest-ROI tech investment available
Consumer backlash against ‘surge pricing’ at restaurants, concerts, and ridesharing fuels demand for transparency; growing public awareness of algorithmic price discrimination raises brand trust risk

LLMs enable natural-language pricing explanations and agentic CPQ deal guidance; GenAI conversational analytics (Revionics 2025) lower adoption barriers; agentic workflows automate deal pricing end-to-end

AI pricing engines applied to real-time energy and carbon-credit markets create a new green-tech use case (EV charging, smart grid arbitrage); compute carbon footprint of real-time repricing inference at scale is [unverified]

EU AI Act (phased 2025–2026) imposes transparency and audit obligations on AI pricing systems; US FTC increasing scrutiny of algorithmic price discrimination; antitrust risk of algorithmic collusion across competitors using shared AI vendors

jobs.job: Retailers need to reprice millions of SKUs in real-time while staying competitive and protecting margins
jobs.solution: AI-driven dynamic repricing at SKU/store level (Revionics, Competera) — adjusts prices based on demand, competitor moves, and inventory signals without manual intervention

jobs.job: B2B sales teams leak margin on deal discounting — reps override AI-suggested prices and give away profit
jobs.solution: AI-guided deal scoring and CPQ optimization (PROS/Conga, Vendavo on SAP BTP) — real-time guidance surfaces approved discount ranges and win-probability signals per deal

jobs.job: SaaS companies struggle to price new AI features and usage-based tiers without historical demand data
jobs.solution: Willingness-to-pay modeling and value-based pricing analytics (Pricefx, Paddle) — simulate buyer sensitivity across cohorts before committing to published prices

jobs.job: Global manufacturers need consistent list prices while accommodating local market and channel conditions
jobs.solution: Segment-based price waterfall management (Vendavo, Zilliant) — set global floors and ceilings while delegating regional variance within approved guardrails

jobs.job: Travel and hospitality revenue managers need to maximize yield across seasonal, event-driven, and last-minute demand
jobs.solution: Real-time AI revenue management (PROS Travel, IDeaS) — demand forecasting + constrained inventory optimization adjusts room rates and fares by the minute

market.name: Pricefx
market.loved: Cloud-native, fast implementation, strong manufacturing + retail use cases; 40% revenue growth in 2023; $138.6M total raised

market.name: Vendavo
market.loved: Deep SAP integration, strong B2B manufacturing + distribution; AI Pricing Assistant on SAP BTP (Apr 2026); chemicals + industrial vertical leader

market.name: PROS Holdings / Conga
market.loved: Market leader; acquired by Thoma Bravo $1.4B (Dec 2025); B2B merged with Conga creating CPQ+pricing powerhouse; travel business runs standalone

market.name: Revionics (Aptos)
market.loved: Retail pricing AI leader; IDC MarketScape Leader 2024–25; GenAI Conversational Analytics on Google Cloud/Gemini; Tractor Supply + Coborn’s clients

market.name: Competera
market.loved: Store-level AI pricing + competitive price intelligence; Gartner Representative Vendor 2024; $3M seed round; growing US retail footprint

competitors.name: Pricefx
competitors.detail: Germany-based cloud-native SaaS; $138.6M total raised across 6 rounds; Series C $65M led by Apax Digital (Jul 2020); 40% revenue growth + 83% ARR-per-customer growth in 2023; covers price setting, optimization, CPQ, and quoting

competitors.name: Vendavo
competitors.detail: B2B pricing + selling solutions for manufacturing, distribution, and chemicals; deep SAP S/4HANA + SAP Commerce Cloud integration; launched AI Pricing Assistant on SAP BTP with natural-language explanations (Apr 2026)

competitors.name: PROS Holdings → Conga (Thoma Bravo)
competitors.detail: Acquired by Thoma Bravo for $1.4B all-cash (Dec 9, 2025) at $23.25/share; B2B arm merged with Conga (CPQ + CLM platform); travel pricing operates as PROS Travel standalone; combined entity creates end-to-end revenue lifecycle platform

competitors.name: Revionics (Aptos)
competitors.detail: Acquired by Aptos; retail pricing + promotions AI leader; IDC MarketScape Leader for retail promotions management 2024–25; Conversational Analytics with Google Cloud Gemini integration; clients include Tractor Supply and Coborn’s

competitors.name: Zilliant
competitors.detail: AI-driven B2B pricing and revenue optimization; products cover price management, analytics, optimization, CPQ, and sales agreement tools; particularly strong in distribution, services, and industrial manufacturing

canvas.who: Chief Pricing Officers, VP Revenue Operations, and merchandising leads at mid-to-large enterprises (500+ employees); B2B sales ops and deal desk teams; e-commerce pricing managers at retailers with 10K+ SKUs
canvas.where: Enterprise software stack: SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce CRM, Shopify Plus, Oracle ERP; deal rooms and CPQ workflows; e-commerce platforms and ERP price masters; retail shelf management systems
canvas.why_now: Post-inflation margin squeeze + supply chain volatility + GenAI cost drops make AI pricing both urgent and economically accessible; $1.4B PROS acquisition signals B2B market maturation; EU regulatory pressure forces transparency investment today
canvas.behavior: Shifting from annual Excel-based price reviews to continuous AI-driven optimization cycles; moving from cost-plus to value-based pricing models; increasing use of LLM chatbots for pricing rationale explainability; agentic CPQ automation compressing deal approval cycles from days to minutes
canvas.unmet: Real-time pricing explainability (‘why did this price change?’); cross-channel price consistency without manual overrides; ethical guardrails preventing discriminatory personalization; SMB-accessible pricing intelligence without $100K+ implementation costs

takeaways: Evaluate CPQ + pricing platforms with native LLM integration now: the Vendavo/SAP BTP launch and PROS/Conga merger signal rapid consolidation — platforms with agentic deal guidance will dominate the next enterprise wave, and switching costs are rising fast

Build price transparency infrastructure ahead of regulation: EU AI Act and Digital Fairness Act obligations are phasing in 2025–2026 — companies that invest in audit trails, explainability layers, and consumer-facing pricing rationale now will avoid costly retrofits

Target B2B margin leakage as the quick-win: McKinsey’s finding that a 1% price lift generates 6–14% operating profit means even a modest AI pricing pilot delivers measurable ROI within 12 months — use this to build internal budget for larger transformation

Watch the SMB democratization wave: cloud-native SaaS entry pricing ($10K–$25K ARR) is unlocking pricing AI for mid-market companies; expect a wave of SMB-focused pricing copilots to challenge enterprise incumbents by 2027–2028
